settings.title: Hero Section Settings
settings.description: Set the banner image upload limit and the banner cache time on user screens.

max_upload_mb.label: Maximum image size (MB)
max_upload_mb.hint: Maximum size of one banner image (1–10). Files larger than the server PHP upload_max_filesize or post_max_size are still rejected even if this value is higher.
max_upload_mb.over_server_limit: This value is larger than the server limit ({{mb}}MB). Files over that limit cannot be uploaded.

public_cache_minutes.label: Banner cache time on user screens (minutes)
public_cache_minutes.hint: Set 0 to disable caching (0–60). Saving, deleting or reordering banners is reflected immediately, and the cache also expires at scheduled start and end times.

plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown read-only.

admin.title: Hero Section
admin.description: Manage the banners shown at the top of the site home and shop main pages, by position.

position.hint: A position is a hero section slot (extension point) provided by the user template.

reorder.title: Reorder banners
reorder.description: Drag rows or use the ↑↓ buttons, then press [Save]. The user page and preview follow the new order.

delete.title: Delete banner
delete.warning: The banner and its PC and mobile images are deleted right away and cannot be restored. To take it down temporarily, hide it instead.

form.description: Set the banner text, images, link and display period. The preview on the right shows your unsaved input.
form.position_hint: A hero section slot provided by the current user template.
form.is_active_hint: When off, the banner is hidden on the user page regardless of its period (inactive).
form.locale_hint: You can enter text for each language enabled on the site. Empty languages show the site default language text.
form.title: Title
form.button_text_hint: If filled, only the button is a link; if empty, the whole banner is a link.
form.image_alt_hint: Read aloud to visitors who cannot see the screen. If empty, the title is read.

image.pc_hint: Recommended 1920×640 · up to {{mb}}MB · JPG, PNG, WEBP
image.mobile_hint: Optional · recommended 750×1000 · up to {{mb}}MB · Without it, mobile shows the PC image.
image.size_mismatch: The uploaded image is {{width}}×{{height}}. It differs from the recommended size ({{recommended}}) and may be cropped on some screens.

form.link_url_hint: Only site paths (starting with /) or http(s) URLs are allowed.

period.hint: If saved now, the banner will be {{status}}.
period.incomplete: Enter both the start and end date and time.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Upload a PC image to see the preview.
preview.has_button: Pressing the button opens the link.
preview.whole_link: No button — the whole banner is a link.
preview.fallback: Missing text falls back to the site language ({{locale}}) or another available language.

form.upload_pending: An image upload is pending. Retry or remove any failed files before saving.
form.conflict: Another administrator saved changes first. Your input is preserved. Open the latest banner in another tab to compare your changes.
form.conflict_compare: Open the latest banner in another tab

presentation.title: Image framing and text background
presentation.hint: PC uses 1920×640 and mobile uses 750×1000. If no mobile image is uploaded, the PC image is cropped. Adjust the focal points to keep important content visible.
